base.rule: additive: every 1.5 type, message, invariant, machine and fixture is carried unchanged; the status-code enum adds the daily-cap warning and refusal codes

row: Reliability-first program item 23 (D25/S18): daily-cap status codes
providers: DA (WS-1): queue, home pointer, outbox, in one transaction with the invocation ledger
consumers: CX controller (WS-2): inbox, queue worker, home store, outbox publisher
Owner clients (desktop, phone): Stop of a follow-up or an occurrence

s3.delete: never (the executor role has no s3:DeleteObject)
s3.sealing: packages/cloud-controller seal(): AES-256-GCM, key HKDF-SHA256(workloadKey, salt 'atum.cloud-controller.sealed/1', info 'seal\u0000home:v1:<owner>:<agent>'), associated data 'ATUMSEAL1\u0000home:v1:<owner>:<agent>\u0000<kind>:<sha256 hex>'

reserved.0181: WS-1: occurrences per atum.cloud-execution/1 §9 (claim/dispatch/complete/published at /cloud/controller/occurrences), which enqueue into this pack's queue (reserved as 0177 in C0)
reserved.0182: WS-1: cloud_agent_queue, cloud_agent_home, cloud_agent_home_history, cloud_agent_outbox, atum.cloud_controller_agent (reserved as 0175 in C0; after 0180 and 0181, which it references)

synthetic_events.followup: $atum-followup-<parentInvocationId>.<waitDeviceServiceId>, in the item's room (the follow-up's own invocation; WS-2 followupEventId)
synthetic_events.occurrence: $atum-occurrence-<occurrenceId>, in the schedule's room (the occurrence's invocation; 0181)

controller_to_platform.description: The controller to DA with its credential; DA derives owner and agent from the executor.

controller_store.description: Objects the controller seals into S3; never read by DA.

conformance.description: Typed test vectors; not wire payloads.

local_to_platform.description: A local executor to DA with its current domain credential; DA derives owner and agent from the executor.

amendments.change: the closed status-code enum adds daily_cap_warning (the one-time quiet 80% line in the agent's main conversation; it does not close the message or the turn) and daily_cap (the 100% refusal: the current call finishes, later calls and later turns are refused for the rest of the Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh day, and the status is terminal for that message). Neither code is couldnt_confirm. A cap of 0 emits neither code; a routine refused by the cap records reason daily_cap and posts one summary line. The status body shape, outbox machine, routes and parameters do not change
